issue.title: Regression: Continuous testing does not detect new test classes after changing sources
issue.body:
### Describe the bug

This issue is similar to https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/18795 (that has been already fixed), but happens after updating some existing sources.

Given having a Quarkus application running in DEV mode and with the continuous testing enabled, 
When we update an existing source
And we copy a test java class into the sources
Then the test should be detected and executed

After updating the existing code and copy the test java class, we got the next traces:

```
10:38:48.999 INFO  [app] __  ____  __  _____   ___  __ ____  ______ 
10:38:49.000 INFO  [app]  --/ __ \/ / / / _ | / _ \/ //_/ / / / __/ 
10:38:49.000 INFO  [app]  -/ /_/ / /_/ / __ |/ , _/ ,< / /_/ /\ \   
10:38:49.000 INFO  [app] --\___\_\____/_/ |_/_/|_/_/|_|\____/___/   
10:38:49.001 INFO  [app] 10:38:45,530 test-http 1.0.0-SNAPSHOT on JVM (powered by Quarkus 999-SNAPSHOT) started in 0.271s. Listening on: http://localhost:27001
10:38:49.001 INFO  [app] 10:38:45,530 Profile DevModeHttpMinimumIT activated. Live Coding activated.
10:38:49.001 INFO  [app] 10:38:45,531 Installed features: [cdi, resteasy, resteasy-jackson, smallrye-context-propagation]
10:38:49.002 INFO  [app] 10:38:45,531 Live reload total time: 0.607s 
10:38:53.003 INFO  [app] Running tests for the first time
10:38:53.004 INFO  [app] Press [h] for more options>
10:38:53.005 INFO  [app] Press [r] to re-run, [h] for more options>
10:38:53.005 INFO  [app] No tests found
10:38:53.006 INFO  [app] 10:38:49,798 Not re-running failed tests, as all tests passed
```

I think the problem could be around the `Not re-running failed tests, as all tests passed` log message.

### Expected behavior

_No response_

### Actual behavior

_No response_

### How to Reproduce?

1. git clone `https://github.com/Sgitario/quarkus-test-suite`
2. cd quarkus-test-suite
3. git checkout reproducer_18883
4. cd http/http-minimum
5. run the test `mvn clean verify -Dit.test=DevModeHttpMinimumIT#shouldDetectNewTestsAfterMakingChanges`

The test is failing and it should pass.

Start writing Quarkus code, but have no test yet.
Run `mvn quarkus:dev`. The continuous test options line is shown

Now add a test and type 'r'un in the console, the test is not picked up.
One has to stop Quarkus and re-run `mvn quarkus:dev`.
